title: Autonomous periodic-energy investigation of HIAM-234b interpenetration
difficulty_reasons: The agent must select and defend an independent periodic electronic-structure protocol for large MOF cells.
The agent must construct and validate a one-net comparator from an interwoven crystal and justify convergence and limitations.

paper.title: Deconstructing and Rationalizing Interpenetration in Pillar-Layered Metal–Organic Frameworks
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: CCDC identifier and answer-neutral definitions of the HIAM-234b 2IP and NIP periodic models.

required_deliverables.description: JSON report of model validation, independent method, normalized energies, conclusion and limitations.
